note: Machine-readable design standards. Agents read this before writing any HTML. Single source of truth for palette, forbidden patterns, component HTML, and template pipeline.

logo.note: Always inline SVG wordmark — no text/CSS logo, no tag

forbidden.rule: Headers must be white with 3px brand border-bottom
Body background must be #fff, never gray
Section numbers are plain colored text, no filled circles
Sections use flat border-bottom separators, not card wrappers
Only the 11 standard palette vars allowed
No arbitrary hex colors — use CSS variables from shared-base.css.html
No external CSS frameworks — all files must be self-contained
No external font imports — system font stack only
Never use a text or CSS logo — always the inline SVG wordmark
No dark-background metric cards — use .stat-row/.stat (white bg, brand border-top)
Intake forms save to Firestore only — no mailto: in form submit
Never hardcode contact emails in templates — read architectEmail from project.json

collapsibleSection.css: details.section-block { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) } summary.section-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; cursor:pointer; padding:14px 40px; list-style:none } .section-eyebrow { font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--brand) } .section-title { font-size:16px; font-weight:700; color:var(--dark) } .section-chevron { font-size:11px; color:var(--mid); transition:transform 0.2s } details.section-block[open] .section-chevron { transform:rotate(180deg) } .section-body { padding:4px 40px 24px }
rules: Key sections default open: Challenge, Solution, Flows, Investment, Next Steps
Secondary sections default collapsed: Journey, Outcomes, Timeline, Included, OOS, Assumptions
Conditional sections (ROI, About) emitted by fill-template.js when data present

knowledge-base.note: Generated from live JSON/YAML/MD sources at deploy time. Uses the 3-column-docs-shell pattern — the standard for all internal knowledge pages.

3-column-docs-shell.usage: All internal knowledge/reference pages. Use this pattern — never invent a new layout for internal docs.
3-column-docs-shell.description: Sticky top bar + 3-column grid: left nav (200px, sticky, section jumplinks), main content (flex: 1fr), right nav (180px, sticky, subsection links auto-built by JS scroll-spy).
3-column-docs-shell.gridCss: .docs-shell { display:grid; grid-template-columns:200px 1fr 180px; min-height:calc(100vh - 44px); max-width:1440px; margin:0 auto; }
3-column-docs-shell.topBarCss: .top-bar { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:200; background:#fff; border-bottom:2px solid var(--brand); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:0 20px; height:44px; }
3-column-docs-shell.navLeftCss: .nav-left { position:sticky; top:44px; height:calc(100vh - 44px); overflow-y:auto; border-right:1px solid var(--border); padding:14px 0 24px; }
3-column-docs-shell.navRightCss: .nav-right { position:sticky; top:44px; height:calc(100vh - 44px); overflow-y:auto; border-left:1px solid var(--border); padding:14px 0 24px; }
3-column-docs-shell.headingAnchors: h2 = left-nav sections (scroll-margin-top:52px), h3 = right-nav subsections (auto-built by JS)
3-column-docs-shell.scrollSpy: JS reads all h2/h3 from #docContent, builds both navs, updates active states on scroll
rules: Left nav links to h2 sections only — one per section
Right nav is built by JS scroll-spy from h3s within the active h2 section
Top bar is sticky at 44px height, white background, brand red bottom border
Body background is #fff — never gray or dark
Responsive: right nav hides at 1100px, left nav goes static at 720px

accessRules.internal: Firebase Google auth required, restricted to @dataskate.ai
accessRules.external: Publicly accessible — share via direct link or embed in client portal

dateFormat.note: All user-visible dates across portals, proposals, and intake forms must use this format. ISO dates from JSON/storage must be converted at render time.
